name: lemlist
description: lemlist lets agents read campaigns, leads, and campaign statistics, and draft sequences and lead lists in the signed-in team. Each user signs in to their own lemlist account through the browser.

prompts.text: Compare the reply rates of my active campaigns.
Which leads were marked as interested this week?
Draft a four-step sequence for agency founders, but do not launch it.

apps.name: lemlist
apps.description: Campaigns, leads, and statistics, over lemlist's MCP server with browser sign-in.
